def: properly, to become aged, i.e. (by implication) to grow gray

words.word: with us are both the grayheaded

occurrences.text: And now, behold, the king walketh before you: and I am old and grayheaded; and, behold, my sons are with you: and I have walked before you from my childhood unto this day.
With us are both the grayheaded and very aged men, much elder than thy father.
words: With us are both the grayheaded
